title: Server Monitoring
description: Entry point for the server dashboards. Charts live on Infrastructure Overview and Server Detail.

options.content:
## Server health

Open **Infrastructure Overview** for the count of healthy, warning, critical, and offline servers.

Open **Server Detail** for CPU, memory, disk, network, services, and what to check next.

This page used to repeat the same charts. Those charts now live on the two dashboards above so the numbers are not shown twice.
